'''Hazer''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who appears as a minor character in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. He is a member of the [[Varrios Los Aztecas]] gang. He does not speak during his [[Los Desperados|only appearance]].

==Character history==
Hazer, at an unknown time, joined the [[Varrios Los Aztecas]] and became a loyal follower of the [[Gang Leaders|gang's leader]] [[Cesar Vialpando]]. Following the [[The Green Sabre|usurption]] of [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]] by the [[Ballas]], the [[Los Santos Vagos]] and [[C.R.A.S.H.]], the Varrios Los Aztecas were forced to relinquish control of their territory, [[El Corona]] and [[Little Mexico]]. Shortly after Cesar's ally and brother-in-law-in-courtship [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] [[Home Coming|returns]] to Los Santos with Cesar after a long exile, Cesar approaches Carl to help him reclaim El Corona. Carl and Cesar are joined by Hazer, [[Gal]] and [[Sunny]] and [[Los Desperados|successfully force]] the Los Santos Vagos out. During the fight, however, Hazer is shot and his fate remains unknown, despite Cesar telling Carl he will take Hazer to the hospital.
